text:
eva (Product): Quick sync — ACME private pilot is greenlit by sales but we have two immediate blockers: HSM onboarding is queued in security and prewarm capacity conflicts with Beacon. Customer expects a private pilot in ~3 weeks. Can infra/runtime/security confirm feasibility?

devon (Eng): what are the hard SLOs here? latency vs throughput will change runtime work.

sanjay (Runtime): For their profile we need 99th < 200ms at ~512 tokens ideally. If HSM can't land in 3w, we can run a KMS-only pilot and gate certain compliance features. HSM required for signing/attestation path though.

olivia (Infra): We have two candidate capacity slots: Apr05 and Apr19. Apr05 currently earmarked for Beacon. If Beacon can shift to Apr19 we can give ACME Apr05. Otherwise ACME moves to Apr19. Need product decision.

zane (Security): HSM onboarding + attestation + audit takes ~2w of security engineering plus customer questionnaire turnaround. KMS-only path is doable in 3-5d if the customer accepts that. Also need SOC docs.

eva (Product): Customer prefers HSM for compliance. Tradeoff: pilot with KMS now + feature-gate until HSM, or delay pilot for full HSM. What are the minimal launch criteria to unblock a pilot?

devon (Eng): Minimal acceptance: (1) E2E auth and tenancy separation, (2) token/accounting parity, (3) a fallback model with same API contract (degraded perf ok), (4) basic observability. Runtime can deliver fallback now.

sanjay (Runtime): I'll scope the fallback model + KV prewarm. Estimated: 3 dev days + 1 ops day to wire the harness and smoke tests. If infra gives Apr05 slot we can prewarm prior to pilot.

olivia (Infra): I'll create a provisional reservation. Runbook command we use: 

```
reserver create --name acme-pilot --slot Apr19 --gpu A100:4
```

If we target Apr05 instead I'll update slot accordingly. Need a tracker update from product to finalize.

zane (Security): If we target Apr19 we can complete HSM onboarding in time, but I need ACME's security contact and questionnaire filled out by EOW to meet that cadence. No expedited path without docs.

deploy-bot: New capacity reservation created: slot-ACME-Apr19 (provisional).

devon (Eng): I'll draft a minimal acceptance test list (invocations + perf thresholds + canary steps). ETA end of day tomorrow.

eva (Product): Draft acceptance checklist (short):
1) E2E auth + authz verified
2) Token accounting matches billing contract
3) Canary run with ~100 concurrent users (smoke)
4) Successful failover to fallback model under load
5) HSM attestation OR documented KMS agreement for pilot
I'll put this into Confluence and update the Launch Window.

sanjay (Runtime): I'll add perf scripts and a smoke harness to the repo. ETA 4d.

olivia (Infra): Holding Apr19 slot provisional. Pinged infra-ops for burst GPU pool and prewarm quotas.

zane (Security): Sent questionnaire to ACME contact now, copying product. Expect answers in ~48h.

eva (Product): Action items: eva->update tracker and confirm Beacon PO shift; olivia->hold/reserve slot; sanjay->perf harness; devon->acceptance tests; zane->security questionnaire follow-up. Reconvene Thu 10:00am to finalize window. :thumbsup:
